president.bio: Olayinka Hakeem Babalola, a member of the Rotary Club of Trans Amadi, Nigeria, has been selected by the Board of Directors to become Rotary International’s president for 2026-27. His term will begin on 1 July 2026.

dg.bio: Rajan Dua leads Rotary District 3141 in 2026-27.

president.bio: Larry A. Lunsford, a member of the Rotary Club of Kansas City-Plaza, Missouri. Lunsford attended what is now Truman State University in Kirksville, Missouri, on an academic scholarship, earning bachelor’s and master’s degrees in accounting.

dg.bio: Deepak Jiandani will lead Rotary District 3141 in 2027-28.
